relations.evidence: yasmin nṛpeśa (!) sthitirājamallaḥ ... bhunakti | tasmin samālikhya vīrādisiṃho

date.as_written: samvatsare bhūtakhapañcaseṣe māse site śrāvaṇajīvavāre | pūrvvādiṣāḍhe ṛkṣa kāmatithau

notes: Year given in bhūtasaṃkhyā: bhūta (5) kha (0) pañca (5) read right-to-left = 505; era not stated but NS fits the reign of Jayasthitimalla (1382–1395), so NS 505 = 1385 CE. 'vīrādisiṃha' is a metrical expansion of Vīrasiṃha (ādi inserted as filler), matching the catalogue's scribe field; likewise 'mahādilakṣmīṃ' = Mahālakṣmī (text title, not a person). 'sthitirājamallaḥ' = King Sthitimalla of the catalogue (Jayasthitirājamalla). 'kāmatithi' = 13th tithi. No place or purpose stated.
